capabilities: Draw the notes of a base as graph nodes
Create labeled arrows from connector notes and regular links
Style nodes, links and labels with cascading rule tables
Group notes by property into collapsible outlined groups
Switch between force, frozen force and tree layouts
extras: Makes no network requests; rule tables are saved in the .base file, while node positions, tree layouts and collapsed groups are stored in plugin data. Filter-style conditions rely on part of the internal Bases API and fall back to a simplified evaluator if that changes. A demo vault with a family graph is included.
intentEvidence: What makes it different from the core graph
problem: Bases present notes as tables and lists but give no way to see how the notes in a base link to each other, or how notes describe relationships between other notes.

relations.evidence: install with the BRAT plugin using this repository's URL

summary: Graph view for Obsidian Bases that turns notes into nodes and draws labeled arrows from connector notes, styled by cascading rule tables.
